claim_scope: predictive replication only; no causal or quantum advantage claim

eligibility.perpetual_pair: USDT linear perpetual BTC and ETH
required_derivatives: basis or premium with mark/index semantics
required_spot: trade count or source trade activity to verify Amihud ingredients
eligibility.spot_pair: BTCUSDT or mechanically equivalent USDT spot instrument

external_data_inspection_before_fit: Allowed only for schema, coverage, timestamps, semantics, missingness, duplicates, contract definitions, and deterministic target construction. Forecast scores remain unopened until frozen protocol and split hashes exist.

feature_sets.S0: Exactly frozen targeted-study SpotOnly registry; six past/current 4-hour slots t-5..t of each registered spot feature plus calendar features.
feature_sets.derivatives_residual_input: Exactly frozen derivative-only feature registry: funding, OI log change, futures taker imbalance, basis and registered transformations/interactions/calendar controls; no spot features in residual learner.

primary_endpoints.delta_full: MAE(SpotOnly) - MAE(SpotOnly + QML residual correction); positive favors correction
primary_endpoints.delta_qml_mlp: MAE(SpotOnly + matched MLP residual correction) - MAE(SpotOnly + QML residual correction); positive favors QML

prohibited: No qubit/architecture/feature/transform/hyperparameter search, no performance-based venue selection, no hardware advantage claim.

BTC.circuit: AngleEmbedding(Y) plus 2 StronglyEntanglingLayers; Pauli-Z vector, trainable linear output

ETH.circuit: AngleEmbedding(Y) plus 2 StronglyEntanglingLayers; Pauli-Z vector, trainable linear output

residual_comparators.selection_basis: prior targeted-study frozen development evidence only; external-venue performance is prohibited from selection

BTC.selection_source: prior frozen development CV; not reselected on external holdout

ETH.selection_source: prior frozen development CV; not reselected on external holdout

residual_construction: Chronological training-only OOF SpotOnly predictions using frozen asset-specific family and frozen development-selected config; residual = transformed target minus OOF prediction. No in-sample residuals.

BTC.selection_source: prior frozen development CV; not reselected on external holdout

ETH.selection_source: prior frozen development CV; not reselected on external holdout

study: Phase 9 external-venue replication of frozen QML residual learning for 24h spot illiquidity

target.definition: Frozen 24-hour future spot Amihud; arithmetic mean over next six 4-hour observations, t+1..t+6, complete window only.
target.raw_formula: 1e6 * abs(4h log return) / USDT quote volume

temporal_split.calendar_sensitivity: Only if it uses no model results and loses no material common coverage.
temporal_split.rule: Longest common contiguous valid 4-hour period for BTC and ETH after data-quality filtering; chronological 70% train / 30% untouched holdout; split computed before any model fitting. At least 18 months total.

venue_selection_rule: Include every candidate venue passing the prespecified data-quality and semantic-parity gates; do not inspect any forecast output before venue inclusion is frozen.
